name: frontend-quality-starter
description: A quality-focused React, Vite, and TypeScript starter.

scripts.build: node scripts/run-commands.mjs build tsc -b ::: vite build ::: node scripts/check-build-security.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/run-commands.mjs test vitest run ::: node --test scripts/check-release-tag.test.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: node scripts/run-commands.mjs test-coverage vitest run --coverage ::: node --test scripts/check-release-tag.test.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:install: node scripts/run-commands.mjs playwright-install npx playwright install chromium
scripts.test:e2e:install:all: node scripts/run-commands.mjs playwright-install-all npx playwright install chromium firefox webkit
scripts.test:e2e:install:ci: node scripts/run-commands.mjs playwright-install-ci npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
scripts.storybook:build: node scripts/run-commands.mjs storybook-build storybook build ::: node scripts/check-storybook.mjs
scripts.verify: node scripts/run-commands.mjs verify npm run format:check ::: npm run lint ::: npm run typecheck ::: npm run test:coverage ::: npm run build ::: npm run storybook:build ::: npm run docs:check
